decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting rests directly on the firm's deep knowledge of robust, standards-compliant specialist lighting, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and keep improving the line.
As a second-generation general interior luminaire, it builds on established LED and in-house testing know-how, so the firm can readily interpret its results and refine it.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship tied to the firm's proprietary optics research and its glare-free, efficient lighting direction, so the firm keeps learning from and investing in it.

The marine searchlight line fits the firm's established marine and robust-lighting competence and can be migrated toward LED, so it remains well absorbed.
